mike: Ran a quick synthetic sweep on the small-batch path and noticed a p95 bump when prefill=true on 2k seqs. attaching numbers + artifact link :eyes:

jen: oh no — short summary?

mike: summary: p95 up ~3x, throughput -12%, mem +150MB. repro steps below and full artifact: https://s3.redwood/bench/3167890123/summary.html

mike: ```
model: redwood-4x
config: microbatch=8 prefill=true kv-shard=4
p50: 28ms -> 35ms
p95: 42ms -> 118ms
p99: 210ms -> 330ms
throughput: -12%
mem: +150MB
```

oliver: was kv-shard=4 the only difference?

mike: reran without prefill and p95 returns to ~45ms. so prefill path + kv-shard looks suspect.

sara: PR #8301 touched prefill refactor — can we hold that merge until we confirm? need 2nd opinion from @oliver and a quick bench across a couple instance types.

oliver: I'll run a focused microbench (same config) on PR-8301 now, ETA ~30m. will post numbers here.

bench-bot: Benchmark run uploaded: s3://redwood/bench/3167890123/run-001/summary.html

jen: if oliver reproduces, we should gate the merge or add a post-merge canary with auto-revert window. not comfortable merging before EOD.

mike: +1 hold. i'll reserve the merge slot for 4h and stand by for a hotfix.

sara: adding to merge-blockers doc and pinging release coord. tagging @oncall for visibility.

oncall: thanks for the heads up — keep me posted. if this looks like a flaky mem thrash we may want a rollback plan and an ops runbook snippet.

mike: will update with oliver's numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:
